articles.title: BTC/USDT Trading Strategy: SMMA + Fibonacci + Volume Profile
articles.description: ## 1. Strategy Overview This strategy combines trend identification, Fibonacci retracement levels, volume-based price zones, and dynamic support/resistance to identify potential trading opportunities in BTC/USDT. The primary objective is to identify high-probability pullback entries after a directional move, while maintaining a predefined stop-loss and favorable risk-to-reward ratio. **Market:** BTC/USDT Futures **Chart timeframe:** 15 minutes **Indicators and tools:** - SMMA 10 (OHLC4) - SMMA 20 (OHLC4) - Fibonacci retracement and extension levels - Volume Profile - Horizontal support and resistance zones ## 2. Trend Identification Using SMMA The 10-period and 20-period Smoothed Moving Averages (SMMA) are used to assess market direction and momentum. **Bullish conditions:** - SMMA 10 is above SMMA 20. - Both moving averages are sloping upward. - Price holds above the moving averages or reclaims them after a pullback. **Bearish conditions:** - SMMA 10 moves below SMMA 20. - Both moving averages begin sloping downward. - Price breaks below the moving averages and fails to reclaim them. A moving-average crossover alone is not considered a sufficient entry signal. Price structure and confirmation are also required. ## 3. Fibonacci Retracement and Extension Fibonacci levels are drawn from a clearly identifiable swing low to swing high during an upward move, or from a swing high to swing low during a downward move. Key levels used in the analysis include: - 0.382: shallow retracement zone - 0.5: intermediate retracement - 0.618: deeper retracement zone - 0.786: deeper pullback reference - 1.0: original swing boundary Extensions can be used to identify potential continuation targets. These levels are treated as potential reaction zones rather than guaranteed reversal points. The swing points should be selected consistently and updated when market structure changes. ## 4. Volume Profile and Market Structure Volume Profile helps identify price areas with relatively high trading activity. - **High-volume nodes:** Potential areas of acceptance, consolidation, or support/resistance. - **Point of Control (POC):** The price level with the highest traded volume within the selected profile. - **Low-volume nodes:** Potential areas where price may move through relatively quickly. - **Horizontal levels:** Previous swing highs, swing lows, and breakout/rejection zones. A Fibonacci level overlapping with a meaningful volume area or previous support/resistance provides a stronger confluence than an isolated indicator signal. ## 5. Long Entry Logic A potential long setup is considered when: 1. The broader price structure is bullish. 2. SMMA 10 is above SMMA 20, preferably with both averages rising. 3. Price retraces toward a relevant Fibonacci level or support zone. 4. The pullback holds, and a bullish rejection candle or confirmed bullish structure break appears. 5. Volume and price behavior support the potential continuation. **Entry:** After the confirmation candle closes. **Stop-loss:** Below the relevant swing low or invalidation level, with a buffer appropriate to current volatility. **Take-profit:** The next meaningful resistance, previous swing high, or a predefined risk-to-reward target. ## 6. Short Entry Logic A potential short setup is considered when: 1. Price structure becomes bearish. 2. SMMA 10 is below SMMA 20, preferably with both averages falling. 3. Price retraces into a Fibonacci resistance or previous support-turned-resistance zone. 4. A bearish rejection candle or confirmed bearish structure break appears. **Stop-loss:** Above the relevant swing high or invalidation level. **Take-profit:** The next meaningful support, previous swing low, or a predefined risk-to-reward target. ## 7. Risk Management Risk management is an essential part of the strategy. - Define the stop-loss before entering a trade. - Consider risking only 0.5–1% of account equity per trade. - Prefer setups offering at least a 1:1.5 risk-to-reward ratio after estimated fees and slippage. - Avoid chasing candles after an extended move. - Avoid entering when price is moving sideways and the moving averages are repeatedly crossing. - Use isolated margin and understand the liquidation risk associated with futures leverage. ## 8. Example From the Chart In the illustrated BTC/USDT setup, price rallied from the lower swing region toward the upper resistance area before experiencing a sharp bearish move. The decline brought price back toward the marked horizontal level around 82,978, with the moving averages turning downward. This suggests a possible bearish momentum shift. However, the level around 82,978 must be evaluated as potential resistance only if price retests it and shows bearish rejection. A breakdown by itself does not guarantee further downside. The next decision should depend on the candle close, the reaction at the broken level, and the surrounding support zones. ## 9. Important Notes This is a confluence-based technical analysis framework, not a guaranteed-profit system. Fibonacci levels, moving averages, and Volume Profile are historical analytical tools and may produce false signals. The strategy should be back tested on BTC/USDT futures data, including trading fees, slippage, funding where applicable, and realistic stop-loss execution, before being used with real capital. **Core principle: Trend + Retracement + Volume/Structure Confluence + Candle Confirmation + Risk Management.** *Educational content only. This is not financial advice.*

articles.title: Asian Para Games 2026: Dilip & Basil Repeat CWG Feat; Win 100m Gold & Silver Respectively
articles.description: It was yet another podium finish for India as Dilip Gavit and Mohammad Basil finished with gold and silver respectively in the 100m T47 race at the Asian Para Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Their names entered the history books by securing a double podium finish at the Paloma Mizhua Stadium. Commonwealth Games 2026 RepeatWhat made this feat even more special is that earlier this year, the duo had done the same at the Commonwealth Games 2026. On that occasion as well, Dilip won gold while Basil took home silver. They proved they could do it again. © X/SAI MediaHow Did They Become Handicapped? For those who are unaware, the T45-47 categories are for athletes who have upper limb impairments. Dilip's right arm was amputated when he was five and fell from a tree, and Basil was born without one limb. Dilip Gavit's TimingDilip normally takes part in the T46 category. This time he won gold with a time of 10.69 seconds. He had won the CWG gold by clocking 10.71 seconds, which was a Games record. It's his second Asian Para Games gold after being 1st in the 400m T47 race in Hangzhou in 2023. © X/SAI MediaMohammad Basil Setting New RecordsBasil's timing was 10.72 seconds, which is a Games record in the T47 category. This is his best time, too. At the CWG, he clocked 10.83 seconds. It's his first Asian Para Games medal. How Many Gold Medals Shall India Win at Asian Para Games 2026? In the recently concluded Asian Games 2026, India finished fourth with 21 gold medals out of an overall haul of 85. It remains to be seen where they end up in the Asian Para Games 2026 that began on October 18 and shall end on October 24.

articles.title: IEC turns to TikTok to help keep voters informed
articles.description: IEC turns to TikTok to help keep voters informed Estelle. Bronkhorst Thu, 10/22/2026 - 07:00 JOHANNESBURG - The IEC is turning to social media to encourage voter participation ahead of the Local Government Elections. But the spread of misinformation on these platforms poses a challenge to efforts to keep voters informed. TikTok Southern Africa is partnering with the Electoral Commission to help combat disinformation and protect the integrity of the elections. READ: IEC partners with tech giants to fight disinformation "The in-app election centre actually plays a critical role in ensuring that we are able to expeditiously review and identify content that could potentially mislead our users on our platform and undermine the integrity of the elections," said TikTok Southern Africa's Tholoana Ncheke-Mahlaela. "What we also do is we label content. So whether it is AI-generated content, we label that content so that our viewers or rather our users, know what it is that they're interacting with. "And we also indicate by label whether or not a piece of video has been, or rather is, unverifiable."
